name: Sliding Leg Curl
steps: Lie on your back on a smooth floor with your heels resting on folded towels, knees bent, and arms flat beside your torso.
Brace your core and lift your hips into a glute bridge so your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Keep your hips elevated as you slide both heels slowly forward until your legs extend nearly straight.
Dig your heels down and pull them forcefully back under your knees while lifting your hips slightly higher at the finish.
tips: Keep your glutes engaged so your lower back does not arch or drop onto the floor as your legs extend.
Control the outward slide slowly if pulling back bilaterally feels too demanding at first.
